about: What this feeder has recorded, how YA-WAMF works, and what it stores and sends.
dashboard: The last 24 hours at your feeder, and anything waiting on you.
events: Browse, filter, and manage every classified visit.
add_observation: Classify your own photo or video, review the evidence, and add it to your history.
audio_history: Calls BirdNET-Go has heard, by species and source.
notifications: Visits, alerts and background work, newest first.
species: Which birds visit most, how often, and when.
health: Whether YA-WAMF is working, what the host is doing, and what happened.

settings_section.cameras: Where events come from: Frigate, its MQTT broker and the cameras to watch.
settings_section.identification: How sure a name must be, the models that find and name birds and their hardware, and features still in Beta.
settings_section.alerts: When you hear about a visit, and the channels the message goes to.
settings_section.sharing: Your feeder’s location and who can open this install, then the other services YA-WAMF reads from or reports to, AI descriptions and telemetry.
settings_section.storage: What is kept and for how long, a backup of these settings, and the jobs that repair or fill in the history.
settings_section.display: How YA-WAMF looks and names birds, and contrast, a reading font, motion and spoken updates.

model_evaluation: How often each installed model names a bird correctly, and how fast.
